node: Skills data, credential verification, labor-market analytics, and learner records
summary: Layer 1B expands the public-company universe around the hypothesized bottleneck of trusted workforce/credential data. The cleanest listed exposure is not traditional edtech but employment/background verification, payroll-record data pipes, and skills-intelligence platforms. Reference lane: Equifax, because The Work Number is a scaled employment/income verification database. Underfollowed lane: First Advantage as a direct background/education/work-history verification provider; Coursera as a small-cap skills graph/credential data platform tied to universities and employers; Paylocity as a second-order payroll/HCM data source feeding verification infrastructure. Private/non-listed leaders such as Lightcast and National Student Clearinghouse remain important coverage gaps for later private-comparable/customer-mapping work.
